highlights.reason_zh: 公共 API、价格和 100 万 token 上下文都已落地，模型路由团队可以直接用真实任务核对厂商自报性能。
highlights.reason_en: The public API, pricing and 1M-token context are live, letting model-routing teams test publisher claims on real work.

highlights.reason_zh: 稳定 API/ABI 契约降低本地推理集成风险，服务端加固也改变生产升级判断，但主版本会移除旧接口。
highlights.reason_en: A stable API/ABI contract and server hardening lower local-inference integration risk, while the major version removes old interfaces.

highlights.reason_zh: ChatGPT 进入真实支付边界，但美国小范围、逐笔人工确认与不支持委托消费是理解产品阶段的关键限制。
highlights.reason_en: ChatGPT reaches a real payment boundary, but narrow US rollout, per-purchase approval and no delegated spending define the current stage.

highlights.reason_zh: LLMON 权重和工具包可复跑，为指令与不可信数据分界提供工程方案；静态厂商测试不能代表多轮安全。
highlights.reason_en: Reproducible LLMON weights and tooling offer an engineering boundary between instructions and untrusted data, but static publisher tests do not prove multi-turn safety.

highlights.reason_zh: XYBench 把“照字面做”与“理解真实目标”变成可复跑指标，直接关联编程助手与客服 agent 的可靠性。
highlights.reason_en: XYBench makes literal execution versus recovering the real goal reproducible, directly testing coding-assistant and support-agent reliability.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功并读完，并补搜官方模型发布、开源、小团队、研究、基础设施、政策与重大综合新闻。XYBench 的 feed 时间距截止约两分钟；Gemini、LLMON 与 CapLite 的效果主要来自发布方或作者实验，尚待独立复现。本轮没有重大综合新闻补充。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were read, with active discovery across official model releases, open source, small teams, research, infrastructure, policy and major general news. XYBench's feed timestamp was about two minutes before cutoff; Gemini, LLMON and CapLite results remain mainly publisher- or author-run and await independent reproduction. No major general-news supplement was selected.
